title: Sharp Noether-type inequalities for $3$-folds of intermediate Kodaira dimensions
summary: For a smooth projective $3$-fold $V$ of intermediate Kodaira dimension, we establish Noether-type inequalities relating the Iitaka volume $\operatorname{Ivol}(V)$ and the geometric genus $p_g(V)$. Specifically, for a smooth projective $3$-fold $V$ of Kodaira dimension $2$, we show that $\operatorname{Ivol}(V)\geq \frac{3}{4}p_g(V)-\frac{5}{4};$ while if the Kodaira dimension of $V$ is $1$, then $\operatorname{Ivol}(V)\geq p_g(V)-1.$ Both inequalities are sharp.
